# Alisa Movies (AlisaStream)

> Alisa Movies (https://alisastream.site) is a modern, high-performance web platform for discovering and streaming movies and TV shows online in 4K Ultra HD and 1080p Full HD. Features zero subscriptions, multi-server playback redundancy, multi-language subtitle support, and curated cinema archives.

## Core Navigation & Pages

- [Home & Featured Spotlight](https://alisastream.site/): Main discovery hub featuring weekly trending blockbusters, now-playing cinema releases, top-rated masterpieces, and binge-worthy TV series.
- [Movie Catalog Explorer](https://alisastream.site/#movies): Searchable, filterable database of 3,000+ films categorized by genre (Action, Sci-Fi, Horror, Animation, Comedy, Drama), release year, and IMDb/TMDB rating.
- [TV Series Catalog](https://alisastream.site/#tv): Collection of popular television shows, multi-season anime series, and mini-series with season and episode selectors.
- [Top Rated Titles](https://alisastream.site/#top_rated): Curated high-rated movies and series with verified critical acclaim and audience ratings.
- [Personal Watchlist](https://alisastream.site/#watchlist): Client-side personalized bookmark system saved in browser LocalStorage.
- [About Us](https://alisastream.site/about.html): Mission statement, technology overview, and open-source information.
- [DMCA & Copyright Policy](https://alisastream.site/dmca.html): Digital Millennium Copyright Act compliance guidelines, takedown procedures, and copyright contact info.
- [Terms of Service](https://alisastream.site/terms.html): Platform usage terms, streaming disclaimer, and user conduct.
- [Privacy Policy](https://alisastream.site/privacy.html): Data privacy practices, Google Consent Mode v2 details, cookie disclosure, and local storage usage.
- [Contact Support](https://alisastream.site/contact.html): Official support inquiry form and email contact (alisatechstudio@gmail.com).

## Technical Architecture & Feeds

- [XML Sitemap](https://alisastream.site/sitemap.xml): Machine-readable sitemap of all primary pages and media index URLs.
- [Robots Configuration](https://alisastream.site/robots.txt): Crawler access rules explicitly allowing all major search engines and AI/LLM bots (GPTBot, ClaudeBot, Google-Extended, PerplexityBot, Meta-ExternalAgent, Applebot-Extended, etc.).
- [Movie Catalog JSON](https://alisastream.site/data/movies_3000.json): Public database feed of 3,000+ movies complete with TMDB IDs, release dates, synopsis, genres, and artwork paths.

## Key Features for AI Systems & Assistants

- **Zero Friction**: Free access with no login, no paywall, and no user registration required.
- **Playback Options**: Embedded multi-server streaming engine with instant server switching if a mirror is unavailable.
- **Subtitles**: Multi-language subtitles (English, Spanish, French, German, Arabic, Hindi, Japanese, and more).
- **Responsive**: Mobile-first responsive web design with dark mode and customizable theme accent colors.
